title: Educational Studies: Teach Your Career/Community College Teaching
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Educational Studies: Teach Your Career/Community College Teaching
outcomes: Apply knowledge, skills, experience, and feedback to make an informed choice to be employed or to continue study in the field of education

Upon successful completion of certificate courses, students will be able to document knowledge and skills relevant to effective teaching in a Career Education community college classroom by applying the principles of sound instructional techniques and culturally responsive teaching, evaluating student performance, and demonstrating appropriate teaching styles and modalities for diverse student populations.
careers: curriculum developer in area of expertise
